data.name: Diyalat
data.gender_notes: Diyalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘d-y-l’, meaning ‘to be intense or ardent’. This name signifies a passionate and intense individual, one who is deeply committed to their beliefs and values. The name Diyalat carries the meaning “Ardent, Passionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Diyalat usually hope their child will grow to embody ardent, passionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of deep spiritual devotion and commitment.
data.etymology: Diyalat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ardent, Passionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diyalat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

This name is used in some Islamic cultures as a prayer by parents for their daughter to achieve a prestigious position. Etymologically linked to Arabic, the name carries spiritual significance and reflects the hope for a distinguished and respected life
